text: My favorite thing to do after school is play video games with my friend Sam. Yesterday, we played Minecraft for a long time. We built a huge castle made of stone and glass, but then a Creeper blew up the front door! I yelled, "Oh no, run away!" After that, we switched to Roblox and played a game where you have to hide from a scary monster. It was so funny when Sam got caught. Later, my mom said we had to stop, so I watched a little bit of Pokemon on TV before dinner. I love Pikachu the best.

I couldn’t believe my eyes when I walked into the kitchen. No way! My dog Buster was standing on the table, and he had my whole birthday cake in his mouth. "Buster, get down!" I yelled, but he didn't listen. He just wagged his tail like it was a game. Oh man! Mom is going to be so mad when she sees this. We're definitely not having cake tonight. Just dog slobber. Gross! I tried to grab the plate, but he jumped off and ran to the living room. What a disaster!

Today was a really good day. I woke up early and ate toast with jam for breakfast. It was yummy. Then I went to school on the big yellow bus. We played tag at recess and I ran very fast. My friend Sam gave me half of his apple. After school, I came home and played with my dog, Spot. He likes to chase his red ball. For dinner, we had pizza with lots of cheese. Now I am tired and ready for bed. Goodnight!

Yesterday after school, I ran to my room to play Roblox with my best friend, Sam. We played a game called "Adopt Me" where you get cool pets. I traded my neon cat for a dragon, and Sam was so jealous! Then my mom yelled, "Time for dinner!" but I wanted to keep playing. After we ate pizza, my brother let me watch him play Fortnite. He is really good at building forts. Before bed, I watched one episode of Pokémon on TV. Pikachu is my favorite because he is super strong and cute. I wish I had a real Pikachu.

I can’t believe we’re finally going to the water park today! It’s been raining for a whole week, but now the sun is out. Oh man! I bet the lines are going to be huge, but I don’t care. My brother says he’s going on the biggest slide first, but I think he’s scared. No way! I’m going to race him to the lazy river. We’re going to get so wet. I hope Mom packed enough snacks because swimming makes me super hungry. Best day ever!

Oh man! I can't believe we actually found it. The secret fort in the woods behind my house. It’s huge! My best friend Leo ran inside first. "Wow! Look at all this stuff!" he yelled. We found old comic books and a rusty box. No way! Maybe it’s treasure? We tried to open it, but the lock was stuck tight. "We need a hammer," I said. But we didn't have one. Just sticks and rocks. We're definitely coming back tomorrow with tools. It's going to be epic!

My dad told me a cool story last night. It was about a brave **knight** who lived on a tiny **island**. The knight **thought** he saw a dragon, so he ran **straight** toward the dark cave. But guess what? It wasn't a dragon at all! He actually **caught** a giant green parrot instead. The parrot was loud but nice. My dad said that was **enough** adventure for one day, so the knight went to sleep. I wish I had a parrot like that.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and had toast for breakfast. It had lots of butter on it. Then I went to the park with my big brother. We played catch with a red ball. The sun was hot so we got ice cream from a truck. I got chocolate and he got vanilla. My ice cream melted on my hand and it was sticky. When we got home, I watched TV and then I ate pizza for dinner. Now I am tired and ready for bed.

I love playing Roblox with my best friend Sam. Yesterday, we played a game called Adopt Me where you get cool pets. I really wanted the dragon, but it costs too much money. After that, we switched to Minecraft. We built a huge house made of diamonds and dirt. It looked funny. My mom said, "Turn off the TV now!" but I asked for five more minutes. Then we watched a show about Pokemon. Pikachu is my favorite because he is yellow and super fast. I wish I had a real Pikachu.

I can’t believe what happened at recess today. It was crazy! We were playing tag near the big slide, and suddenly, Sam tripped over his own feet. Oh man! He fell right into a huge puddle of mud. Splat! Everyone stopped running. We thought he was hurt, but then he stood up and looked like a chocolate monster. No way! Even his hair was brown. Sam started laughing, and then we all started laughing too. It’s definitely the funniest thing I’ve ever seen. I hope he brings extra clothes tomorrow!

My big sister acted like a brave knight in a game we played yesterday. She made a fort out of blankets and said it was a secret island. I tried to run straight inside, but she caught me! "You cannot pass!" she yelled. I thought she was being mean, but then she smiled. "Just kidding," she said. We crawled through the tunnel and ate cookies until we had enough. It was the best game ever.

Yesterday after school, I played Minecraft with my best friend Sam. We built a huge castle out of stone blocks. "Watch out for the creeper!" Sam yelled. I quickly ran away before it exploded. Boom! It made a big hole in our garden. Then we switched to playing Roblox. We played a game where we had to escape from a scary piggy. It was so funny because my character kept falling down. Later, my mom said we had to stop, so we watched a Pokemon show on TV. I want to catch a Pikachu someday.

I couldn't believe my eyes when I walked into the kitchen. No way! My dog, Buster, was standing on the table eating the birthday cake. "Buster, get down!" I yelled, but he didn't listen. He just licked the chocolate frosting off his nose. It’s supposed to be for Mom’s party tonight! Oh man, we're in so much trouble. I grabbed his collar, but it was too late. Half the cake was gone. "You're a bad boy," I whispered, trying not to laugh. He looked so happy with blue icing all over his paws. Wow! Mom is going to freak out.

I couldn't believe my eyes when I walked into the kitchen. No way! My dog Buster was standing on top of the table eating my birthday cake. "Buster, get down!" I yelled, but he just licked blue frosting off his nose. It's not fair. Mom said we're having pizza later, but now we don't have any dessert. Oh man! The cake was smashed flat like a pancake. I hope Mom doesn't get too mad, but Buster looks really happy. At least he didn't eat the candles.

Today was a very fun day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It had lots of butter on it. Then I went to the park with my dad. We played catch with a red ball. It was the best day ever because I did not have any homework. I am very tired now. Goodnight!

I can't believe we're finally going to the water park! It’s going to be the best day ever. My brother said he’s going on the giant slide first, but I said, "No way! That thing is huge." We packed our towels and sunscreen, but I think mom forgot the snacks. Oh man! I hope she didn't. We're leaving in five minutes. I'm so excited I can hardly stand still. Wow! Look at the car, dad already put the floaties in the back. Let's go!

Yesterday, my dog Buster found something huge in the backyard. I mean, huge! At first, I thought it was just a rock, but then Buster started barking like crazy. "What is it, boy?" I asked. He wouldn't stop digging. Dirt was flying everywhere! Then I saw it. A giant bone. No way! It looked like a dinosaur bone or something. "Mom! Dad! Come look!" I yelled. We're gonna be rich! But then Mom came out and laughed. She said it was just an old cow bone from the farm next door. Oh man! I really wanted a T-Rex.

One day a brave **knight** went on a long trip to a secret **island**. He had to walk **through** a dark forest where the trees were super tall. Suddenly, he **caught** a little rabbit that was running away. He **thought** about keeping it, but he knew he had **enough** pets at home already. So he let the bunny go **straight** back to its mommy. The knight was happy he did the right thing.

One day a brave **knight** went to a big **island** to find a dragon. He walked **straight** into the dark woods. Suddenly, he heard a loud roar! The dragon jumped out, but the knight wasn't scared. He **thought** of a good plan. He threw a big net and **caught** the dragon's tail. "That is **enough** roaring for today!" said the knight. Then the king's **daughter** came out and gave the dragon a cookie. They all became friends and walked **through** the forest together.

After school, I came home and played with my dog, Spot. He likes to chase the ball. Then my mom made pizza for dinner. I love pizza with cheese. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too. Good night!

I can't believe what happened at recess today! We were playing kickball, and suddenly, boom! Jeremy kicked the ball so hard it went over the big fence. No way! Usually, we aren't allowed to get it, but Mrs. K said okay this one time. We all ran to the spooky woods behind the school. It’s super dark back there. Oh man! I thought I saw a monster, but it was just a squirrel. We found the ball, but we’re never going back there again. Too scary!

I was sad but then we talked about building a huge castle in Minecraft later.

I almost screamed. It landed on the monkey bars and just stared at us. "No way!" said Sarah. "It wants to play too!" We tried to get it to chase us, but it just ran up a tree. Oh man! I wish we had a pet squirrel at school. That would be the best thing ever.

I **thought** I was going to get a bruise, but she is strong **enough** to hold me up. Then our mom said dinner was ready, so we had to stop saving the kingdom to eat pizza.

My big sister said she saw a **knight** in the backyard, but I **thought** she was lying. We went outside to look, running **straight** to the big oak tree. I looked **through** the bushes and guess what? It wasn't a knight at all! It was just our dog Buster who got **caught** in a shiny silver blanket. We laughed so hard my tummy hurt. It was funny **enough** to make milk come out of my nose!

It’s super dark in the backyard tonight. We’re supposed to be camping out, but my brother Ben is scared. "Did you hear that?" he whispered. I told him it was just a squirrel, but he hid under his sleeping bag anyway. Oh man! Suddenly, a huge shadow moved across the tent. No way! Is it a bear? I grabbed my flashlight and unzipped the door really fast. It was just our dog, Buster. "Wow, you scared us!" I yelled. Ben peeked out. "I knew it wasn't a monster," he said. Yeah, right.

My dad and I went fishing on a tiny island in the middle of the lake. I threw my line straight into the water and waited. Suddenly, my pole bent way down! "I think you caught a big one!" Dad yelled. I pulled hard, but the fish was strong enough to almost pull me in. It splashed through the waves and then—snap! The line broke. I thought it was a monster, but Dad laughed and said, "Maybe next time, kiddo."
